real_defects.issue: Geometry.profile had no nesting guard: an IFCDERIVEDPROFILEDEF or IFCCOMPOSITEPROFILEDEF that names itself recursed until RangeError (Maximum call stack size exceeded), shown on the row as 'error: Maximum call stack size exceeded' instead of an unresolved-geometry reason. Fixed with a depth > 50 Unresolved('profile nesting') guard, like placement and curve already had; test in geom.test.mjs.
